findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "check_shopify_csv" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Free. Checks a Shopify product import CSV for the problems that make imports fail or silently go wrong (wrong encoding, Excel-damaged barcodes, missing handles,…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_shopify_csv, request_catalog_conversion · Private data: request_catalog_conversion · Public sink: request_catalog_conversion.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_shopify_csv, request_catalog_conversion · Private data: request_catalog_conversion · Public sink: request_catalog_conversion

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
